title: Perfect for tiny treasures
text: Perfect for tiny treasures. I got this for my boyfriend to frame a sticker we found in his first house to frame and take with us before he moves out. It’s size is perfect and he absolutely loved it!

product_metadata.title: Beautifully Beaded Photo Frame/Placeholder As seen in the hit movie 27 Dresses
features: "Beautifully Beaded" Photo Frame/Placeholder “As seen in the hit movie 27 Dresses”. Great for all different kinds of celebrations, uses and party themes.
MEASUREMENTS - Frame/Place Card Holder 3.88" w x 2.88" h x 0.5" d. Place card viewing area is 2.75" w x 1.75" h. Place card size 3.81" w x 2.88" h.
VERSATILE - Beautiful silver glitter resin cube place card holders can also be used as photo holders or balloon weights! Metal frame is embellished with dainty, beaded design
GREAT PARTY FAVORS - Give away to your guests as unique party favors, Your happy guests will fill the frame with a favorite photo of their own
CONVENIENT - Coordinating place cards are included. Back of frame is covered with black velvet
description: Picture this bit of elegance enhancing each place setting at your resplendent event! fill the gleaming metal frame with a place card or a favorite photo. When they take this lovely favor home, your happy guests will fill the frame with a favorite photo of their own. Kate Aspen is a leading designer and manufacturer of décor, favors, and gifts for all of life’s celebrations based in Atlanta, Ga. Kate Aspen designers are committed to creating a trend-right original product mix and many of our unique designs are patented and protected by copyright. Since 2004, the online boutique has expanded from its wide selection of all event favors to include small gifts as well as décor for special events and home. Kate Aspen is always ready to add that extra special touch for you, from around the home to life’s celebrations like weddings, baby showers and birthdays.
